purpose: Adversarial evidence integrity cases for the BioNexus Evidence Engine (MATRIX 9 / ANN-AI rows). Each case is a deliberately hostile input: fabricated claims, wrong identifiers, unsupported numbers, reversed interpretations, structurally broken graphs.
contract: Cases are labelled `reject` (the engine MUST reject the fabricated input via the given check) or `gap` (the current structural engine legitimately cannot catch the semantic fabrication — recorded as a documented, tracked limitation, never silently passed). Semantic entailment cases in `gap` require the external semantic audit layer; they are part of the release-honesty register, not a pass.

cases.name: Numeric fabrication
cases.expect_reason: numeric claim absent from supporting computation/reference payload

cases.expect_reason: no recorded evidence node supports this statement
